name: Sanguine Batter
description: Open with a heavy overstroke from the head, then check the pommel's return for the second stroke.

name: Vanishing Pound
description: Shift between two guard stances in one step so the head and the pommel can each lead.

name: Evergreen Ironknob
description: Parry one blow with the head and the next with the pommel in an unbroken turn of the haft.

name: Dentscourge
description: Alternate head and pommel strikes down the same line so each blow follows the other before the guard resets.

name: Fastening Wristloop
description: Hook both head and pommel behind a limb and draw the pair together to bind it.

name: Chime Crush
description: Ring head against pommel to send a sharp tone down the haft that jars an opponent's grip.

name: Nova Smash
description: Drive both heads into the same plate in turn so doubled qi tears the metal open.

name: Ponderous Studhead
description: Cast qi along the haft into an opponent's weapon arm and press both heads down until the guard collapses.

name: Decimating Glint Pearhead
description: Cast the whole weight of both heads into one point, crushing the guard and the armor behind it together.

name: Batterwrath
description: Strike lacquered plate at a single point until the finish cracks and the metal beneath rings.

name: Pulp Obduracy
description: Hook the flange behind a plate edge and pull so the cuirass rides up and exposes the flank.

name: Murkpear
description: Turn a blade away along the haft with a slow, wide arc of the whole forearm.

name: Macerespite
description: Extend the field along the haft to read the plate's thickness before committing to a blow.

name: Ironmace
description: Peel a layered guard apart blow by blow, striking each layer's seam in turn with qi in the head.

name: Gustbatter
description: Close along a shallow curve like a basin's slope so the opponent cannot back away in a straight line.

name: Facet Haftring
description: Send a pulse of qi into the cuirass so the shock rebounds from the back plate into the wearer.

name: Dentwrath
description: Smash the top plate in and follow through to flatten the plate beneath it against the body.

name: Unsparing Flangerib
description: Cast the full field's weight down in a wide stroke that bursts plate across every opponent in close reach.

name: Rumble Bellhead
description: Cast a single stroke that breaks plate and turns the target's own counterblow back along the haft.

name: Gust Ribhead
description: Let the weight flow down the haft into the head and carry the swing downstream onto the target.

name: Chime Wristloop
description: Check the opponent's swing with one head and send the other round to strike the exposed side.

name: Dazzling Dent
description: Turn the stance across a short river-like curve so the mace swings from a new side.

name: Murk Maceball
description: Spin the haft in a small eddy that carries an incoming blade round and away from the body.

name: Blaze Smash
description: Draw weight from both heads into one stroke so the combined mass lands on a single point.

name: Charter Dent
description: Press the haft down on a weapon arm as a river's weight breaks a bank, forcing it to the ground.

name: Rampaging Maceball
description: Gather the field's weight over several beats and release it in one stroke through the guard.

name: Slag Pearhead
description: Let the weight spill sideways from the paired heads in a sweep that catches opponents either side.

name: Glint Flangerib
description: Cast both heads down on a river of qi, crushing the target and driving the shock outward through those beside it.

name: Tempered Maceneck
description: Smash down along the strike track while the guard track keeps the haft braced against a counter.

name: Bellhead Obduracy
description: Reset to a basin-shaped guard with head low and pommel high, ready for any line of attack.

name: Dazzling Pound
description: Cross from one track to the other on one step so the opponent loses the line of the next blow.

name: Chime Ribhead
description: Parry two blows in turn, one on each track, without disturbing the grip.

name: Rumble Ironknob
description: Strike with the knob along the guard track while the head remains ready to answer.

name: Blaze Crush
description: Strike and guard in the same moment by letting the haft's far end ward off the counter.

name: Ponderous Maceneck
description: Cross the haft over the opponent's weapon and bind both tracks together before the opponent can free either.

name: Numbing Pulp
description: Hold the opponent's weapon pressed into the basin of the guard and seal its motion with qi in the haft.

name: Blistering Pound
description: Mark one weak point from the guard track, then drop the head onto it with the full field behind the stroke.

name: Crushing Batter
description: Break the opponent's guard along both tracks at once with a crushing stroke driven by qi through the haft.

name: Smashscourge
description: Cast a crushing stroke along one track while the other holds a basin-shaped guard that no counter passes.

name: Shattering Maceneck
description: Pick out the one seam in a suit and land the head on it with a measured stoop.

name: Torrent Smash
description: Rise on the front foot and hold the perch for a heartbeat before the descent.

name: Impervious Studhead
description: Keep the haft high from the perch so an incoming blow glances off its upper end.

name: Wristloop Respite
description: Spread a thin field to read the weight and give of the opponent's armor from outside.

name: Poundspine
description: Dive with the flange onto an arm plate and hook it before the descent finishes.

name: Gust Flangerib
description: Stoop, rebound, and stoop again in a chain so each descent lands on a fresh seam.

name: Shademace
description: Cast the head's weight onto the guard like a talon closing and hold it there until the arm tires.

name: Hollowcrush
description: Drive the whole descent into the marked seam so qi passes through the gap into the flesh beneath.

name: Rampaging Rumble Haftring
description: Cast a single marked descent after reading the enemy's armor through the field, and strike the weak point.

name: Gust Pulp
description: Swing the twin heads overhead and bring them down on the target with the full strength of a mortal body.

name: Lightning Ironknob
description: Step in a court's measured rank, never faster than the heavy heads can follow.

name: Pearhead Valor
description: Parry with the haft's two ends in turn, passing the blade from one to the other.

name: Tempered Ribhead
description: Drive qi down both arms at once into the twin heads so the blow lands doubled.

name: Immobilizing Bellhead
description: Rap the pommel on an opponent's lead hand at the moment they raise a blow.

name: Thornrib
description: Hold the twin heads crossed in front and take a charge on the cross with qi in the meridians.

name: Lacerating Maceball
description: Bring a crushing stroke right to the limit of a mortal body's qi and drive it through plate.

name: Charter Haftring
description: Press both heads on the guard at once and let the dual meridian flow force it down.

name: Crushwrath
description: Cast the twin heads' whole weight into a single point, crushing guard and armor with the last of a Monarch's reserve.

name: Corroding Crush
description: Open by drawing a first current into the head and driving it onto the guard in a single smash.

name: Poundflash
description: Gather a second current into the legs as the step is taken, adding speed to the approach.

name: Hoarfrost Studhead
description: Raise the haft and let a broad current of qi spread along it as a shield against the blow.

name: Wristloop Obduracy
description: Meet a blade with one current and turn it along a second, so the parry carries it off the line.

name: Ironknob Reckoning
description: Split the stroke into several branches of qi across the target's guard like a delta.

name: Fastening Bellhead
description: Draw a tributary current across the haft and use it to bind the opponent's weapon where the two touch.

name: Shadecrush
description: Gather two currents in the head and crush a raised guard so the arm behind it drops.

name: Mayhempear
description: Bring the confluence down wide so the stroke floods the whole ground in front of the wielder.

name: Glamour Pearhead
description: Let the opponent's own blow flow back into the haft, and return it as a counterstroke along the same current.

name: Novapound
description: Gather every current into the head and drive it through plate and bone in a single descending stroke.

name: Batternerve
description: Cast the river's weight down on the opponent's weapon and hold it pressed to the ground by qi alone.

name: Gnashing Batter Scourge
description: Cast every gathered current at once, breaking the target and spreading the shock through all in close reach.

name: Crushscourge
description: Strike at the edge of the guard's basin so the head clears the rim and lands inside.

name: Granite Maceneck
description: Skip over the rim of an opponent's guard in a short lunge that lands inside the guard.

name: Chimemace
description: Parry a blow with the head and answer with the pommel along the same line.

name: Reverie Smash
description: Feint a stroke just short of the guard, then extend past it to strike the hidden hand.

name: Brutalizing Dent
description: Land two strokes in quick succession on the same guard, the first to open and the second to crush.

name: Ponderous Batter
description: Hook the flange over the outer rim of a guard and draw the whole defence aside.

name: Hourbatter
description: Let a blow's weight spill past the guard onto the body behind, forcing a stumble.

name: Corroding Studhead
description: Carry a pulse of qi past the shield's rim and into the body without a clean contact.

name: Facet Pound
description: Cast paired strokes through a guard that seems whole, breaking it and the stance of the one behind it.

name: Ferocious Crush
description: Pledge the opening swing to its target and carry it through the guard without turning.

name: Mightdent
description: Take a bearing on the opponent and step along it without deviating until the blow lands.

name: Ribvalor
description: Hold the haft at the oath's angle and turn a blow aside along the wood.

name: Gnashing Maceball
description: Roll the head in a wind-like circle and beat the guard from several angles without pause.

name: Gyve Flangerib
description: Hold the opponent at the plateau's edge by pressing the head against their weapon arm.

name: Chime Pulp
description: Check the opponent's advance with a short, heavy blow whenever they step off the bearing.

name: Ribhavoc
description: Drive the gale's weight through the head into plate, the shock reaching the wearer's back.

name: Intent Ironknob
description: Hold the bearing against a charge and strike the guard with the full weight until it falls.

name: Nova Dent
description: Cast the oath's whole weight into a single stroke and crush the target's guard under it.

name: Blazepound
description: Knock the head against the opponent's lead foot to disturb the bearing they hold.

name: Dazzling Haftring
description: Circle the opponent along the plateau's open side where they cannot press forward.

name: Murk Ribhead
description: Deflect with the haft's edge so the blow slides over the plateau of the forearm.

name: Smashhavoc
description: Strike on open ground with the full arc free of any guard.

name: Shadebatter
description: Press the opponent's weapon down while keeping the bearing fixed against any shove.

name: Iron Maceneck
description: Break a held guard with a rolling stroke that lifts and drops the head against it.

name: Mayhem Smash
description: Overturn the opponent's bearing with a low sweep so the stance loses its line.

name: Pulp Havoc
description: Burst armor with a gale of qi carried down the haft into one hard blow.

name: Downpour Studhead
description: Spread the stroke across a wide arc so every opponent in reach feels the gale's weight.

name: Dent Havoc
description: Cast the full gale into a single stroke that breaks the guard in front and shakes those beside it.

name: Rumble Ribhead
description: Add the gale's weight to the overswing as the head falls so the blow lands harder.

name: Mightcrush
description: Advance along a single line with the head held low and level.

name: Inexorable Maceball
description: Hold the bearing against a rush and let the haft take the blow without moving the feet.

name: Murk Flangerib
description: Turn the haft flat like a plateau and slide a blow off to either side.

name: Aegis Pearhead
description: Settle the weight into the planted feet and swear to give no ground to the blow.

name: Batter Fortitude
description: Slide the flange along the haft's edge to bind an arm against the opponent's body.

name: Hour Crush
description: Press the gale's weight into the guard and keep it there for several heartbeats.

name: Granite Bellhead
description: Break the opponent's bearing with a sudden stroke at the knee as they shift their weight.

name: Glint Wristloop
description: Descend with the gale's weight from open sky, driving the head through plate in one fall.

name: Suffocating Pulp
description: Hold the opponent's weapon pressed against the ground with the gale's weight and seal its motion.

name: Titanic Pound
description: Cast the held bearing's whole weight through a single stroke, crushing the guard and pinning the arm behind it.

name: Gust Haftring
description: Strike in the open with no cover and no step back, trusting the oath to carry the blow.

name: Crushvortex
description: Take a broad step across open ground and plant the feet for the heavy stroke.

name: Pearspine
description: Hold the haft in an oath-bound guard and take the blow on its full length.

name: Peardurance
description: Turn the haft like a vane in the wind to parry from any quarter.

name: Mightpulp
description: Rake the flange across a guard in a swearing motion, marking the line the next blow follows.

name: Smashspine
description: Press the opponent back with a heavy stroke and a forward step that never gives ground.

name: Blaze Wristloop
description: Roll the head round in a sweep across open ground, striking every opponent within its arc.

name: Smash Reckoning
description: Drive the oath's weight through the guard and the armor in one pledged stroke.

name: Titanic Maceball
description: Cast the whole oath into one stroke that crushes the guard and holds the plateau against any counter.

name: Iron Ironknob
description: Open by planting a bearing and smashing the guard that first crosses it.

name: Phantom Batter
description: Step along the held bearing and no further, keeping the opponent in front.

name: Ribdurance
description: Parry a blow at the instant it crosses the bearing and push it aside.

name: Rumble Flangerib
description: Check the opponent at the bearing line with the haft's side before they commit a step.

name: Sanguine Pound
description: Rake the flange across the opponent's line of attack and break its direction.

name: Battervalor
description: Press the haft across the opponent's weapon and push it down along the bearing.

name: Shadesmash
description: Stand fixed on the line and bring the head down on every blow that passes it.

name: Shattering Ribhead
description: Gather a gale in the head and break the guard and armor in one stroke.

name: Deed Crush
description: Hold the head on the opponent's weapon and seal it against the bearing.

name: Merciless Haftring Ruin
description: Cast a single stroke along the bearing, breaking the guard and sealing the weapon beneath it.

name: Gust Maceneck
description: Swing the head overhead with the whole mortal body behind it, holding the bearing.

name: Torrent Haftring
description: Step along the bearing with deliberate weight so each step is a new place to hold.

name: Studhead Hardihood
description: Turn blows away with the haft held at the sworn angle.

name: Charter Pearhead
description: Run qi through full meridians into the haft to turn a heavy blow aside.

name: Overbearing Batter
description: Rap the head on the opponent's lead hand when they step off the bearing.

name: Ironknob Ruin
description: Carry the wind's weight down the meridians into one blow that bends the guard.

name: Intent Pearhead
description: Press the haft down on the opponent's arm with the bearing fixed and the meridians open.

name: Ribhead Scourge
description: Send a gale of qi from the meridians into the head and crush plate at the limit of a mortal body.

name: Thorn Wristloop
description: Bind the opponent's weapon to the haft with a held oath and qi through the grip.

name: Wrathful Dent
description: Hold the bearing and press the guard with the head's weight until the arm gives.

name: Slagpulp
description: Roll the head wide around the held bearing and strike everyone who stands within its arc.

name: Ruinous Maceneck
description: Cast the wind's whole weight through a held bearing and crush the guard with the last of a Monarch's reserve.

name: Might Bellhead
description: Open with a descent from a high bearing that drops the head onto the guard.

name: Torrent Crush
description: Slip along the bearing like wind through open air, never stopping on any line.

name: Iron Maceball
description: Hold the haft in open air and let the gale's weight spread along it as a ward.

name: Murk Studhead
description: Parry upward with the haft and let the gale carry the blow wide of the body.

name: Mastering Pulp
description: Bind an arm by sweeping the head round it like wind round a post.

name: Sanguine Smash
description: Tear along the guard's edge with a rake that carries wind's pull in the flange.

name: Intentdent
description: Press the gale's weight onto any guard until it gives, however well built it may be.

name: Ironcrush
description: Drive the gale through the guard as if it were not there, shock reaching the body behind.

name: Rumble Dent
description: Cast the whole gale into one descent that breaks guards in front and shakes every body near.

name: Flangerib Reckoning
description: Hold the wind at the edge of the swing and release it into the blow.

name: Granite Batter
description: Pace along the plateau's edge with the head low and the weight even.

name: Torrent Ribhead
description: Turn the haft at the plateau's edge and send the blow into open air.

name: Eviscerating Ironknob
description: Strike with the knob at the end of a held stroke so the opponent has no time to set.

name: Fastening Pound
description: Hook the flange behind the opponent's arm at the edge of their reach and bind it there.

name: Gust Smash
description: Release the stored wind into a smash that lands with the weight of a whole gale.

name: Intent Bellhead
description: Press the guard at the edge of its reach until the arm fails.

name: Nova Flangerib
description: Crush plate with a stroke released at the edge of the swing, qi flowing through every link of the guard.

name: Rumble Wristloop
description: Cast the held wind in one release that crushes the guard and presses the arm down.
